en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a busy European city street lined with ornate late‑19th‑century buildings. A wide avenue leads into the distance with small figures walking and a few early street fixtures visible. On the right stands a large Baroque church tower with an onion-shaped dome and clock, attached to a steep-roofed building. On the left are richly decorated facades with cupolas and multiple slender spires. Trees and people in period clothing occupy the foreground. A handwritten note with a date appears at the top edge.
